info.name: MagmaNet API
info.description:
Community WiFi control plane for DataSupportApi.

**Base URL** `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:5702`).

**Authentication**
* `/admin/*` and `/internal/*` requests need the `ClientId` and `ClientSecret` headers created by the business API key service; they resolve to a `business_id`, which is the tenant scope for every query.
* `/internal/jobs/*` requests instead send `X-Magma-Internal-Secret` (`MAGMA_INTERNAL_SECRET`).
* `/portal/*` and `/webhooks/*` are public; webhooks are verified with the provider before anything is provisioned.

**Sandbox** With `MAGMA_SANDBOX_PAYMENTS=true` checkout and payouts succeed without contacting Hubtel/Paystack, so the whole purchase flow can be exercised locally.

**Setup** Run migrations 0001-0003, then `SELECT magma_provision_tenant(...)` to create a tenant with the seed plans and a default zone. Set `businessId`, `zoneId`, `zoneCode` and `planId` in the collection variables (the create requests capture IDs automatically).

**Order of a purchase** checkout -> checkout status -> hotspot login, or vouchers/redeem.

item.name: Portal (public)
item.description: Captive portal endpoints. No credentials; the zone is resolved from `?zone=` or the client IP. This is exactly what `portal/index.html` calls.

request.description: Public entry point for the captive portal. Resolves the zone by code (or the requesting client's IP), returns the tenant, active plans, and whether the zone is serving. `business` is only needed when the zone code exists in more than one tenant.
Public plan catalogue for the resolved zone. Prices are tax inclusive in GHS.
Health snapshot used by the portal banner (zone status, device counts, open alerts).

Starts a purchase. In sandbox mode (`MAGMA_SANDBOX_PAYMENTS=true`, the default) the intent is provisioned immediately and the response contains `intentId` plus a `status` of PROVISIONED. In production this triggers the MoMo prompt or the Paystack redirect and returns AWAITING_PAYMENT.

`mac`/`ip` come from the hotspot (`$(mac)` / `$(ip)` in the login page); they bind the plan to this device.
Poll while the customer approves the MoMo prompt. `result.status` is one of NEW, AWAITING_PAYMENT, PROVISIONED, FAILED or EXPIRED.

Called by the portal after a PROVISIONED checkout. The server checks the device's MAC/IP against the gateway host table and then logs the client into the hotspot via RouterOS REST. Returns 409 when the device is not yet visible on the gateway.

Redeems a printed voucher. Codes are normalised (case, dashes and the Crockford look-alikes O/0, I/1, L/1 are folded), so `abc-de1f-gh2j` and `ABCDE1FGH2J` are the same code. The plan is bound to the supplied MAC.

body.raw:
{
  "subject": "No internet after payment",
  "category": "CONNECTIVITY",
  "priority": "NORMAL",
  "description": "Paid for a day pass but the portal still shows the paywall.",
  "msisdn": "0244123456",
  "zoneId": "{{zoneId}}"
}

request.description: Customer-facing ticket creation. `authorType` is forced to CUSTOMER by the server.
Agent app login with MSISDN/email plus PIN. Returns a short-lived signed token and the agent's wallet balance.
Sends a one-time code by SMS to the agent's registered MSISDN.
Completes the reset with the OTP from the SMS.
Dashboard totals: zones, active subscribers, live sessions, revenue today/month, open alerts, outbox backlog.
Per-zone concurrency versus the theoretical sector capacity (5 GHz 20 MHz 2x2 ax is budgeted at 35-60 concurrent clients), plus backhaul headroom.
Zone + device topology with tunnel IPs, last seen, health and customer counts.

item.name: Admin - zones
item.description: Coverage zones, backhaul, costs and per-zone profitability.

request.description: Paged zones. Status is PLANNED, BUILD, LIVE, PAUSED or RETIRED.

request.description: Creates a coverage zone (one gateway/NAS plus N bridged APs). `upstreamIsCgnat` should stay true for consumer MTN/Telecel fibre — RADIUS then arrives over the WireGuard tunnel rather than inbound on a public IP.
Partial update; empty strings leave existing values untouched.
Device online state, last seen, active sessions and open alerts for the zone.
Backhaul, power, rent and maintenance costs recorded against the zone.
Category is BACKHAUL, POWER, RENT, MAINTENANCE, LABOUR or OTHER. Period defaults to the current month when omitted.
Revenue (tax inclusive split into net/VAT/NHIL/GETFund) minus recorded costs, with gross margin per zone.

item.name: Admin - plans
item.description: Plan catalogue, availability and price simulation.

request.description: Plan catalogue. Pass includeInactive=true to see deactivated plans.

`planType` is TIME (durationMinutes), VOLUME (dataCapMb) or UNLIMITED (fair-use throttle: fairUseCapMb then throttleDownKbps/throttleUpKbps). `price` is tax inclusive. `zoneIds` limits availability; an empty list means all zones.
Same body as create. Changes affect new purchases only; existing subscriptions keep their `plan_snapshot`.
Soft delete (is_active=false). Existing subscribers are unaffected.
Which zones can sell the plan, and why not when they cannot.
Dry run: shows the adoption, revenue and bandwidth impact of the proposed prices and caps without writing anything.

item.name: Admin - subscribers
item.description: Subscribers, their devices, usage and lifecycle.

request.description: `q` matches MSISDN, name or email.
`consent` records Data Protection Act consent; `ghanaCardNumber` is encrypted at rest and only ever returned masked.
Partial update. Note: empty fields are ignored, so a field cannot be cleared back to NULL through this endpoint.
Current subscription, remaining minutes/MB, throttled state and device count.
RADIUS accounting history (one row per session, refreshed every 60 s).
Bound client devices, their MACs and blocked state.
Suspends the subscriber and deletes their RADIUS credentials immediately. Connected sessions end at their Session-Timeout unless a CoA disconnect is also issued.
Terminal state; keeps history for reporting.
Blocks a MAC across the tenant (walled-garden only). `mac` may be sent in the body or as a query parameter.

item.name: Admin - subscriptions & money
item.description: Subscriptions, transactions, refunds, invoices, till and reconciliation.

request.description: Subscription detail including the plan snapshot taken at purchase time.
Adds another plan period (or upgrades to `planId`) and re-projects RADIUS. Use for goodwill credits and cash renewals.
Ends the subscription now and issues a CoA disconnect for any live session.
Money in/out. Status is PENDING, SUCCESS, FAILED, REFUNDED or ABANDONED.
Asks the provider for the authoritative status and provisions the plan if it was paid but never activated (callback lost).
Records a refund and ends the linked subscription. Sandbox mode short-circuits the provider call.
Gross, net, VAT/NHIL/GETFund split and average revenue per user for the period.
Generates monthly invoices for PPPOE/postpaid subscribers (auth_type = PPPOE). Safe to re-run; already-invoiced periods are skipped.
Suspends postpaid subscribers past their due date and removes their RADIUS entries.
Cash-up for a date: transactions by method, refunds, net. Omit `date` for today.
Sweeps PENDING transactions older than a few minutes, re-verifies each with the provider and completes or expires it. Safe to run from cron.

item.name: Admin - devices
item.description: Gateway/AP enrolment, config push and health.

request.description: Gateways and APs with tunnel IP, REST endpoint, health and last seen.

Enrols a gateway or AP. Role is GATEWAY or AP; only gateways are NAS clients. The response returns the generated `apiPassword` and `radiusSecret` ONCE — paste them into the RouterOS bootstrap script. Ciphertext columns are omitted from the response.
Marks the device RETIRED and removes it as a RADIUS NAS.
Derives the RouterOS configuration from the device row and zone and pushes it over REST through the tunnel. Returns per-step results; RouterOS errors come back as strings, not exceptions.
System resource, hotspot hosts/active users, and whether the RADIUS NAS entry is reachable.
Health sweep: updates status/last seen, raises DEVICE_OFFLINE alerts after repeated misses. The hourly job calls the same code.

item.name: Operations - vouchers
item.description: Voucher batches, printing, assignment and voiding.

request.description: Batches with plan, zone, quantity, sold/redeemed counts and owner agent.
Generates `quantity` 12-character Crockford codes (HMAC-SHA256 hash for lookup, AES-GCM ciphertext for re-print). Unit price defaults to the plan price; wholesalePrice is what an agent pays.
Returns every code in the batch (decrypted) for printing. Treat the response as cash; the call is audited.
Transfers ownership of the batch to an agent and books the wholesale value against their wallet.
Voids the whole batch, or only the listed `voucherIds`. Redeemed vouchers are never affected.
Stock on hand per plan/zone with unsold, assigned and redeemed counts.

item.name: Operations - agents
item.description: Agent accounts, wallets, stock and settlements.

request.description: `pin` is bcrypt-hashed. `territoryZoneId` limits the agent to one zone; `commissionRate` is a fraction (0.10 = 10%).
Wallet balance, vouchers sold today/month, commission accrued and settlement status.
Ledger lines (top-ups, stock, commission, settlements) for the period.
Debits the agent wallet and assigns a new voucher batch to them.
Pays the agent's available balance to their MoMo wallet. In sandbox mode the payout is auto-approved; in production the result is settled by the Hubtel settlement callback.

item.name: Operations - alerts & monitoring
item.description: Alerts plus bandwidth, concurrency, SLA, health and outbox metrics.

request.description: Severity is INFO, WARNING, CRITICAL. `openOnly` defaults to true.
Manual alert (also raised automatically for device offline, backhaul loss, payment mismatch and outbox backlog).
Counts by severity and type for the last 24 hours/7 days.
Down/up Mbps over time from 60-second accounting samples.
Concurrent sessions over time, for capacity planning against the sector budget.
Availability per zone/device derived from heartbeat gaps.
Device counts, open alerts, outbox backlog, database latency and Redis state.
Pending, retrying and DEAD outbox events by type.

item.name: Operations - reports
item.description: Sales, revenue, subscriber, voucher, agent and tax reports.

query.description: day, week, month, zone, plan or method

request.description: Grouped sales by day/week/month/zone/plan/payment method.
New, active, churned and ARPU over the window.
VAT 15%, NHIL 2.5% and GETFund 2.5% extracted from tax-inclusive prices, for filing.
RFC 4180 CSV inside a JSON string (`result.csv`). `type` is transactions, sales, vouchers, subscribers or agents.

item.name: Operations - support
item.description: Tickets, work orders, staff accounts and the audit log.

body.raw:
{
  "subject": "AP offline at Stall 12",
  "category": "CONNECTIVITY",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "description": "Customer reports no signal since 14:00.",
  "zoneId": "{{zoneId}}",
  "subscriberId": "{{subscriberId}}",
  "authorType": "STAFF"
}

request.description: `slaHours` is derived from priority unless supplied.
`checklist` and `materials` are JSON strings (e.g. "[\"Mount AP\", \"Run cable\"]").
Role is ADMIN, MANAGER, SUPPORT, FIELD or FINANCE. `zoneIds` is a JSON array string.
Identifier is the staff MSISDN or email. Returns a signed token.
Append-only record of privileged actions (suspend, refund, void vouchers, config push, credential issue).

item.name: Operations - outbox
item.description: Manual drain and retry of the outbox queue.

request.description: Processes up to `limit` due events now instead of waiting for the ten-minute job. Useful after a tunnel outage.
Resets a DEAD event to PENDING with attempts=0.

item.name: Internal jobs
item.description: Scheduled entry points. Authenticated with X-Magma-Internal-Secret rather than ClientId/ClientSecret.

request.description: Syncs RADIUS accounting, enforces time/volume limits, applies fair-use throttling, issues CoA disconnects, drains the outbox. Also accepts GET for schedulers that cannot POST.
Device health polling, alert evaluation, RADIUS projection repair.
Monthly invoices, overdue suspensions, daily rollups.
Registers magma-ten-minute (0 */10 * * * ?), magma-hourly (0 0 * * * ?) and magma-daily (0 30 2 * * ?) with the Quartz service. Idempotent.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Provider and device callbacks. Not called by hand in production.

request.description: Configure as the PrimaryCallbackUrl for MoMo collections. The server extracts the client reference, verifies with Hubtel (verification first, never trust the body), tolerates a 0.50 GHS amount difference, and provisions the plan. Amount mismatches raise a CRITICAL PAYMENT_MISMATCH alert.
Card payments. The handler reads `data.reference` (or the query `reference`) and re-verifies with Paystack before provisioning.
Agent payout result. Settles the settlement transaction and mirrors the ledger entry.

First boot of a gateway/AP with the enrolment serial. Marks it ONLINE and returns the desired configuration (RADIUS host/ports/secret, hotspot profile, WireGuard peer). The device token header is optional at enrolment.
Sends resource metrics; omitted fields keep their previous value. The device token is issued at enrolment and checked on every heartbeat.
